description: Check a web page for responsive design problems on real phone, tablet, laptop and desktop viewports (with each device's pixel ratio, touch support and user agent). Returns the problems found on each device: horizontal scrolling and the elements causing it, tap targets under 24px, text under 12px, form fields that make iOS zoom, viewport meta mistakes, clipped text, oversized or blurry images, fixed headers covering the screen, plus console errors per device. Defaults to the six most common screen sizes. Works with localhost. Use it after changing layout or CSS, or when asked whether a site is mobile friendly.

devices.description: Device ids or names from list_devices ("iphone-17", "Galaxy S26"), free-form sizes ("1024x768"), or a preset: default, popular, phones, latest, tablets, desktops, apple, foldables, extremes.

url.description: Page to load: a full URL, a bare host such as example.com, localhost:3000 for a local dev server, or a path to an HTML file

name: check_responsive
